notes: Positive: threat modeling (STRIDE), AuthN/AuthZ design, OWASP review (web/API/LLM/Agentic), encryption + key management strategy, secret-management policy, compliance scoping (SOC2/GDPR/HIPAA/PCI/EU AI Act), vulnerability response and VEX drafting, security review of code, AI/LLM security. Negative: implementing the mitigation, CI pipeline plumbing, cloud-account/IAM provisioning, runtime SIEM ops, physical/HR security, or meta-component edits. Edge: code review with a security focus; LLM features that mix product + security.
